sources: book.wvstateparks.com supplier 11067308 'Beech Fork State Park Electric Campsites' (Ecomm SupplierTile, stays 2026-10-27 to 2027-06-20, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Booking site, one night, Oct-Nov 2026 and Apr-Jun 2027, weeknights and a Friday-Saturday stay alike: 30-amp electric sites in Four Coves, Lake View and Moxley Branch $44.99 or $49.99; Moxley Branch's 50-amp electric/water sites $49.99-54.99; Old Orchard's 50-amp full-hookup sites $59.99. Every reservable site is electric.

hookups.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/beech-fork-state-park/lodging/ ('The year-round Old Orchard campground offers ... full hook-ups with 50-amp electric, water and sewer'; Moxley Branch, Four Coves and Lakeview 30-amp) + booking site unit tags (Old Orchard Full Hookup / Water / Sewer / 50 Amp), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 275 campsites in four campgrounds, 99 of them lakefront: Old Orchard (full hookups, the 48 booking-site sites all tagged pull-through), Moxley Branch (30-amp electric or non-electric; some 50-amp electric/water), Four Coves and Lakeview (30-amp electric only). Booking-site RV-length tags are mostly '30-40 ft', two sites to the 40-60 ft classes.

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/beech-fork-state-park/lodging/ ('Beech Fork offers 275 campsites in four distinct camping areas, of which 99 campsites are lakefront') + booking site unit tags (Pull Thru, RV-length classes), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Coin laundry at Old Orchard; free Wi-Fi at the bathhouse only; Camper's Corner Store.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/beech-fork-state-park/lodging/ ('All of the park's campgrounds have full-service bathhouses and restroom facilities'; Old Orchard 'offers coin-operated laundry'; 'Free Wi-Fi is available at the bathhouse only'; 'Camper's Corner Store'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Old Orchard and Lakeview are open year-round; Moxley Branch mid-April to mid-October; Four Coves mid-April through October.

season.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/beech-fork-state-park/ ('The campgrounds are open year-round') + /lodging/ ('The year-round Old Orchard campground'; 'Moxley Branch campground is open mid-April through mid-October'; 'Four Coves campground is open mid-April through October, and Lakeview campground is open year-round'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Campsites may be reserved anytime online, by phone, or at the campground office.' Two nights minimum on Friday+Saturday, one night Sunday-Thursday. The booking site enforces it for arrivals a month or more out (a one-night Friday was refused for Nov 20 2026 and every Friday tested in 2027) but sold one-night Fridays for Oct 30 and Nov 13 2026, 9 and 23 days ahead. The lodging page says Old Orchard and Moxley Branch sites 'are available for reservation from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend', yet the booking site sells all four campgrounds in October-November and April. Checkout noon.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/beech-fork-state-park/ ('Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or one-night Sunday through Thursday'; 'There is a 14-night maximum stay'; 'Checkout time for all campsites is 12:00 p.m.') + /lodging/ + booking site supplier 11067308 (one night: Tue 2026-10-27 178 sites, Fri 2026-10-30 153, Fri 2026-11-06 84, Fri 2026-11-13 60, Fri 2026-11-20 0, Sat 2026-11-21 0, Fri 2027-01-15 / 03-19 / 05-07 / 06-18 / 09-17 / 10-15 all 0; Tue 2027-04-20 and 06-15 sold), read 2026-10-21

summary: Fees 44.99-59.99 confirmed (prices unchanged); added hookups 50A full, 275 sites/99 lakefront/pull-through, facilities, per-campground season note, and booking (2-night weekend minimum confirmed on the park page and the booking site, 14 max). AWH note left as is.
flags: Registry lead (state:WV): the booking site waives the two-night weekend minimum close to arrival - one-night Fridays were sold 9 and 23 days out (Oct 30, Nov 13 2026) but refused 30 days out (Nov 20) and beyond. The cutoff lies between 24 and 29 days; worth confirming at another park before adding a waived_if to the row.
